Question: Please tell me few easy DUA to read because there is so much disturbance in my family since last two years. Hamare ghar mein aapas mein jhagre bahut hone lage hain. Hamari ek choti sister hai jo shadi ke laik hai uski umar 29 sal ki ho gai hai uski shadi nahin ho pa rahi hai hai rishte aate hain aur usko pasand bhi karte hain lekin bad mein inkar ho jata hai, barai karam koi DUA batain. Answer ID: 10143 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 115/115=H/1429) You should recite the below verse 12 times with durood thrice before and after: ربنا ھب لنا من أ زواجنا و ذریاتنا قرۃ أعین واجعلنا للمتقین إماما All the mature family members should recite it after every obligatory salah, before going to bed and after doing wudhu in the morning. Also, it is better to have a schedule of reading out Bahishti Zewar and Fadhail Aamaal at home, fix a time and get yourselves free for that. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
